description.para: With yes, smbd sends the state of its durable handles to truenas_smbhad through this socket. truenas_smbhad keeps a copy of the state in the memory of the standby controller. When smbd starts, it restores the durable handles from truenas_smbhad.
If truenas_smbhad does not run, for example on a system that is not HA, smbd does not restore durable handles. smbd then works with durable handles as without this option.
